title: Privacy & Cookie Policy
description: Privacy and cookie policy of Hotel Drei Könige Chur: what data we process, why, who receives it and what rights you have.
privacyPolicyHtml:
Privacy Policy

We take the protection of your personal data seriously. This policy explains, briefly and plainly, what data we process when you use this website, contact us or make a booking. It follows the Swiss Federal Act on Data Protection (revFADP) and, where applicable, the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR).

1. Controller

Hotel Drei Könige
Reichsgasse 18
7000 Chur
Switzerland
info@dreikoenige.ch

2. Visiting the website

Our website is hosted by Netlify, Inc. (USA). Each visit records technically necessary data in server log files: IP address, date and time, page requested, referrer, browser and operating system. We need this data to deliver the website, keep it secure and fix problems (legitimate interest, Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR). We do not use any analytics or tracking tools.

3. Content from third parties

To display the website, some content is loaded directly from external servers. For technical reasons, your IP address is sent to the provider concerned:

  • Google Fonts (Google LLC, USA / Google Ireland Ltd.): typefaces, on every page.
  • OpenStreetMap (OpenStreetMap Foundation, United Kingdom): embedded map in the “Practical Matters” section.
  • Unsplash (Unsplash Inc., USA): some images on the home page.
  • Netlify Identity (Netlify, Inc., USA): a small script for our editors to sign in to the content management system; it does nothing for visitors.

The purpose is to display the website consistently and correctly (legitimate interest).

4. Contacting us by email

If you write to info@dreikoenige.ch, we process your details (e.g. name, email address, content of your message) to answer your request and, where relevant, to prepare your stay.

5. Online booking via SimpleBooking

Online bookings are made exclusively through the SimpleBooking booking engine (QNT S.r.l., Florence, Italy). The data you enter there (e.g. name, contact details, dates of stay, payment information) is processed by SimpleBooking and passed on to us so that we can handle your booking and meet our legal obligations (performance of a contract, Art. 6(1)(b) and (c) GDPR). The booking engine is covered by SimpleBooking’s privacy policy.

6. Recipients and transfers abroad

We do not sell personal data. The only recipients are the service providers named above: Netlify (hosting), SimpleBooking (bookings) and Google, OpenStreetMap and Unsplash (website content). Some of them are based in the USA or the United Kingdom. Data is only transferred to countries without an adequate level of data protection with appropriate safeguards, such as the Swiss-U.S. or EU-U.S. Data Privacy Framework or standard contractual clauses. Authorities only receive data where the law requires it.

7. Retention

We keep personal data only as long as needed for the purpose concerned or as required by statutory retention obligations (e.g. accounting records for up to 10 years). Server log files are kept by our host for a short period only.

8. Your rights

You have the right to access, rectify and erase your data, to restrict processing, to object, to data portability and to withdraw any consent you have given, with effect for the future. Please send your request to info@dreikoenige.ch. You may also lodge a complaint with the Swiss Federal Data Protection and Information Commissioner (FDPIC) or with a data protection supervisory authority in the EU.

9. Changes

We will update this policy if our website or the law changes. The version published here applies.
cookiePolicyHtml:
Cookies

Our website itself sets no cookies and stores no data in your browser. We do not use any analytics, advertising or social media tools, which is why we do not show a cookie banner.

Based on our check, the third-party providers named above (Google Fonts, OpenStreetMap, Unsplash) do not set cookies when their content loads, but they do receive your IP address. Netlify Identity stores a sign-in cookie or browser storage entry only when members of our editorial team sign in to the content management system.

The SimpleBooking booking engine runs on its own website and may use its own cookies there. For details, see SimpleBooking’s privacy policy.

You can block or delete cookies at any time in your browser settings.
